title: Pro Evolution Soccer 6
sourceNote: Exact original cover for Pro Evolution Soccer 6. Identified by the article's infobox: | image = PES6.jpg, caption = "European PlayStation 2 cover art featuring Inter Milan's Adriano and Chelsea's John Terry". This is the 2006 title's own box art, not PES 5, PES 2008 or any later PES entry.

supersedes.reason: Previous asset was a 898x162 wide banner logo of the host destination (reading OPTIPROJECTS), not game cover art. Primary agent visually reviewed it and confirmed it is the host logo and irrelevant as a game thumbnail. That file is owned by another worker and was left untouched by this task.

fileSignatureAndSizeMatch: The Wikimedia imageinfo API reported size=21493 and 265x375 for File:PES6.jpg; the downloaded bytes match both exactly, so the file is byte-identical to the source original.

provenance.identifiedVia: Wikipedia article Pro Evolution Soccer 6 (action=query&prop=images -> File:PES6.jpg), then imageinfo for the exact URL.
